summary: The Female Titan breaks the net. Levi's squad is killed while Eren is ordered not to transform, and Levi takes what is left of him out of the forest.

segments.ja: 女型の巨人の叫びは、捕獲の完成を拒む音でした。森の外から巨人が集まり、ワイヤーを噛むように体を押し付けます。硬化した腕が拘束を割り、調査兵団の砲は次の弾を込める速度で負けます。枝の上では、特別作戦班がまだ降りていません。エレンは合図を目で探し、リヴァイは首を縦に振りません。成功していたはずの罠が、敵の第二の計画に変わっていくのを、高い位置から見ることになりました。
segments.en: The Female Titan's scream was the sound of refusing to let the capture finish. Titans gathered from outside the forest and pressed their bodies against the cables as if biting them. A hardened arm split the restraint. The Survey Corps cannon lost to the speed of loading the next shot. In the branches, the Special Operations Squad had still not descended. Eren searched for a signal with his eyes. Levi did not nod. From up high they watched a trap that was supposed to have succeeded turn into the enemy's second plan.

segments.ja: リヴァイの命令は、危険が目に見えるほど大きくなっても待機のままでした。エルドは兵長の横顔を見て、質問を飲みます。グンターはワイヤーに手をかけたまま、まだ発射しません。ペトラはエレンに、今動いたら全員の死が無駄になる、と短い理由を渡します。エレンにはその理由が、見殺しの言い換えに聞こえます。下では知らない兵が女型の巨人に届かれています。知っている同期かもしれない。名前が届かないまま、枝の上の正しさが続きます。
segments.en: Levi's order stayed wait, even after the danger was large enough to see. Eld looked at the Captain's face and swallowed the question. Gunther kept a hand on his cable and did not fire it. Petra gave Eren a short reason. If they moved now, everyone's death would be wasted. To Eren the reason sounded like another way of saying they were leaving people to die. Below them, soldiers he did not know were being reached by the Female Titan. They might be classmates. The correctness in the branches continued while the names did not arrive.

segments.ja: 女型の巨人は、網を破ったあとに枝のほうを見ました。特別作戦班の位置を、知っているように。最初に落ちたのはグンターです。次にエルドが、兵長へ何か伝えようとして届きません。オルオはペトラを庇う角度で遅れて、その遅れが致命になります。名前を一人ずつ失う速度は、審議の言葉より速いものでした。エレンは変身の拳を作り、リヴァイの禁止がその拳よりまだ重いことを知ります。禁止は、仲間の死体の上でも解除されません。
segments.en: After breaking the net, the Female Titan looked toward the branches. As if it knew where the Special Operations Squad was. Gunther fell first. Eld tried to tell the Captain something and did not finish. Oluo was late by the angle it took to cover Petra, and the lateness killed. The speed of losing names one by one was faster than the language of the hearing. Eren made the fist for a transformation and knew that Levi's ban was still heavier than the fist. The ban was not lifted even on top of his comrades' bodies.

segments.ja: ペトラが枝から消えたとき、エレンの中で命令の意味が一度切れます。茶を渡した人、待てと言った人、新兵の失敗を笑い飛ばさなかった人。その人が、女型の巨人の手の中で形を失います。エレンは叫ばず、息だけが漏れます。リヴァイの顔も、そこで初めてわずかに動きました。動いても命令は同じです。まだ変身するな。エレンはその同じ命令を、今度は憎しみに近い耳で聞きます。憎しみの相手は、女型の巨人だけではありません。
segments.en: When Petra vanished from the branch, the meaning of the order broke once inside Eren. The person who had handed him tea. The person who had said to wait. The person who had not laughed off a recruit's failure. That person lost her shape inside the Female Titan's hand. Eren did not scream. Only breath leaked. Levi's face moved, slightly, for the first time there. Even moving, the order was the same. Do not transform yet. Eren heard that same order this time with an ear close to hatred. The hatred was not only for the Female Titan.

segments.en: The signal came after the squad was almost gone. Permission, now, to transform and to fight. Eren felt that the self which had waited for permission was already wrong. His body still obeyed the order, and at last he became a Titan. A transformation that late does not bring back the dead. All it can bring back is the possibility of stopping any further death. The Female Titan turned to face him as if it had been waiting for that transformation. Eren closed the distance meaning to bite.

segments.en: The fight between the two Titans did not last long. Eren's blows were heat and anger. The Female Titan's blows still had the shape of technique. A human fight from training was being repeated in huge bodies. Eren tried to bite and hold, and his teeth did not pass the hard skin. Instead the nape of his neck was taken, and his mind nearly left again. It looked less like a difference in strength than a difference in how clear the purpose was. The Female Titan preferred securing Eren to killing him. That preference was even more frightening.

segments.en: Levi left the branch at the moment Eren started to lose. The Captain's movement was faster than anyone else's in the squad, and it cut the Female Titan's joints with precision. It did not look like a face of revenge. It looked like recovery. Pull the living contents out of the enemy's hand. Eren could not keep the Titan body and fell in a human shape. Levi caught him and chose a road out of the forest. There was no arm left to carry the bodies of the rest of the squad. The result of leaving them was still there, inside the speed.

segments.en: When Hange reached the scene, the capture equipment had already finished being useful. The Female Titan had vanished among the Titans it had called, and the object of study was only bite marks and broken cable. Before anger, Hange tried to record the effect of the scream. A voice that calls Titans. That item had not been in the experiment notes. The report to Erwin became a middle language, neither success nor failure. We caught it. We lost it. We do not know the inside. Eren is alive. The squad is not.

segments.en: On the horse leaving the forest, Eren kept hearing Petra's voice. One sentence: not yet. The result of obeying that sentence was his own survival now. He could not say that the squad would have lived if he had disobeyed. He also could not say they died because he obeyed. While he could not say it, survival remained as the only fact. Levi did not look back. Not looking back looked like the Captain's mourning. Eren could not say thank you. Gratitude would have made the abandonment too clean.

The expedition's aim had been achieved once inside the forest, and lost immediately.

segments.en: The Titans that answered the scream did not gather to eat the Female Titan. They gathered to fill the space around it like a wall. The Survey Corps cannon could fire only at the outside of that wall. Inside, the cables loosened, and the thing they were trying to capture disappeared into the crowd. Hange did not record the movement as an accident. It was an arrangement that had been called. If there was an arrangement, the voice was not only a scream. It was close to an order. segments.en: After Levi recovered Eren, the Captain's own body was not unhurt. The price of the speed that cut joints remained in an arm and a side. He still did not slow the horse. Looking at the blood on the Captain's sleeve, Eren understood for the first time, as an adult unfairness, what it meant to be the one protected. segments.titleEn: Why the order was to wait
segments.ja: 森の外の短い停止で、エレンはようやく質問します。なぜ、班が死ぬまで変身を禁じたのか。リヴァイの答えは長くありません。早く巨人になれば、女型はお前を確保して終わりだった。待つことで、敵の能力と、壁の中に知っている者がいる可能性が見えた。班はその可能性の代金だった。エレンはその代金という言葉を、二度は繰り返させません。繰り返すと、ペトラが代金の内訳になるからです。彼は質問をそこで閉じ、閉じたことが同意ではないと自分に言います。
segments.en: At a short stop outside the forest, Eren finally asked. Why forbid the transformation until the squad was dead. Levi's answer was not long. If you had become a Titan early, the Female Titan would have secured you and finished. By waiting, they saw its ability, and the possibility that someone inside the walls knew. The squad was the price of that possibility. Eren did not make him repeat the word price. If it was repeated, Petra would become an item in the bill. He closed the question there, and told himself that closing it was not agreement.

segments.ja: 合流点で、調査兵団は生存者の数を合わせます。右翼の欠員、中央の特別作戦班の欠員、砲と馬の損失。アルミンは自分の図と、この数字が同じ形をしていることを確認して、紙を裏返します。ジャンは番号を聞き、知っている顔が番号の中にいるたびに頷きを飲みます。エレンの生存は別枠で報告されます。別枠であることが、彼を仲間の列からもう一段外へ出します。遠征の成果欄には、女型の巨人の硬化と叫びだけが、新しい事実として残されました。
segments.en: At the rally point the Survey Corps matched the number of survivors. Gaps on the right wing. Gaps in the Special Operations Squad at the center. Losses of cannon and horses. Armin confirmed that his diagram and these numbers had the same shape, and turned the paper over. Jean heard the numbers and swallowed a nod each time a face he knew was inside a number. Eren's survival was reported in a separate column. Being a separate column moved him one more step out of the line of comrades. In the column of results, only the Female Titan's hardening and its scream were left as new facts.
